name: elysium-testnet-gloam-standin
_why: Nov 13: Gloam has no vault on Elysium testnet yet and its founder is offline, so Cloak runs Gloam's mainnet vault code itself, with HYPE, USDC and KNTQ, as Gloam's Elysium mainnet vault will have. Swapped for Gloam's own with use-gloam-vault.mjs when it exists.
_poseidon: The PoseidonT3 already on testnet (Cloak's earlier Gloam instance and the launch vault use it). Its code is checked by Gloam's deploy.
_kntq: No KNTQ on testnet: a test KNTQ is deployed (anyone can mint). Put an address in kntq.token to use an existing one.
_limits: HYPE and KNTQ at the limits Gloam has queued on its Elysium mainnet vault (12 / 600 HYPE, 1,400 / 70,000 KNTQ), so tests run mainnet's numbers.
_usdcLimits: Gloam's own testnet USDC limits (500 per deposit, 25,000 in total), as in its DeployElysiumTestnet script.
_withdrawFee: 0.5%, Gloam's mainnet cash-out fee, collected by the testnet main wallet.
_controller: The testnet main wallet runs the guard (it accepts with acceptController()); the deploy wallet keeps nothing once it does.
